items.title: Nat Hentoff interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: Oh the sixth is new, she’s a year old, Ruby.

ctx.x: This was a while ago when I got this.

Oh the sixth is new, she’s a year old, Ruby. And her mother is a pianist and piano teacher and composer. I don’t think she named her after Thelonious Monk’s “Ruby My Dear” although she knows the music. Yeah that’s the newest one.
And how many sons and daughters?
